findings.counterexample_cmd:
unshare -r -n bash -s <<'EOS'
ip link set lo up
H=$(printf tok | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
GATE_CONNECT_LISTEN=127.0.0.1:3102 HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT=3999 TUNNEL_TOKEN_HASH=$H /home/dm/pproxy/target/debug/pproxy-gate-server >/dev/null 2>&1 &
G=$!
timeout 15 python3 - <<'PY2' &
import socket
s=socket.socket(); s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1); s.bind(('0.0.0.0',443)); s.listen(4)
c,_=s.accept(); d=b''
while True:
    b=c.recv(4096)
    if not b: break
    d+=b
print('UPSTREAM_GOT', d, flush=True)
PY2
E=$!
sleep 1.5
python3 - <<'PY3'
import socket, base64, time
s=socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',3102), 3)
s.sendall(b'CONNECT 0.0.0.0:443 HTTP/1.1\r\nProxy-Authorization: Basic '+base64.b64encode(b'tok:tok')+b'\r\n\r\nPING1')
time.sleep(0.5); s.sendall(b'PING2'); s.shutdown(socket.SHUT_WR); time.sleep(0.5)
PY3
kill $G $E 2>/dev/null
wait 2>/dev/null
EOS
# 现状输出 UPSTREAM_GOT b'PING2'（与首部同包送达的 PING1 被丢弃）；
# 把 connect_proxy.rs:329 的 buf[..i] 改为整块 buf 后输出 b'PING1PING2'

unshare -r -n bash -s <<'EOS'
ip link set lo up
H=$(printf tok | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
GATE_CONNECT_LISTEN=127.0.0.1:3102 HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT=3999 TUNNEL_TOKEN_HASH=$H /home/dm/pproxy/target/debug/pproxy-gate-server >/dev/null 2>&1 &
G=$!
timeout 15 python3 - >/dev/null 2>&1 <<'PY2' &
import socket
s=socket.socket(); s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1); s.bind(('0.0.0.0',443)); s.listen(8)
while True:
    c,_=s.accept(); c.sendall(b'LOOPBACK-443-REACHED\n'); c.close()
PY2
E=$!
sleep 1.5
python3 - <<'PY3'
import socket, base64, time
auth=base64.b64encode(b'tok:tok').decode()
for t in ['127.0.0.1:443','2130706433:443','0x7f000001:443','0.0.0.0:443']:
    s=socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',3102), 3); s.settimeout(3)
    s.sendall(('CONNECT %s HTTP/1.1\r\nProxy-Authorization: Basic %s\r\n\r\n' % (t, auth)).encode())
    time.sleep(0.3)
    print(t, '->', s.recv(200).split(b'\r\n')[0])
    s.close()
PY3
kill $G $E 2>/dev/null
wait 2>/dev/null
EOS
# 实测：127.0.0.1:443 -> 403 Forbidden；2130706433:443 / 0x7f000001:443 / 0.0.0.0:443 -> 200 Connection Established

unshare -r -n bash -s <<'EOS'
ip link set lo up
H=$(printf tok | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
GATE_CONNECT_LISTEN=127.0.0.1:3102 HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT=3999 TUNNEL_TOKEN_HASH=$H /home/dm/pproxy/target/debug/pproxy-gate-server >/dev/null 2>&1 &
G=$!; export GPID=$G
sleep 1.5
echo "fd_before=$(ls /proc/$G/fd | wc -l)"
python3 -c "
import socket, time, os
s=[socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',3102), 3) for _ in range(600)]
time.sleep(0.6)
print('idle_conns', len(s), 'gate_fds_now', len(os.listdir('/proc/%s/fd' % os.environ['GPID'])))
"
kill $G 2>/dev/null
wait 2>/dev/null
EOS
# 实测 fd_before=12 -> idle_conns 600 gate_fds_now 612：accept 无任何 semaphore/连接上限，1 连接 = 1 fd + 1 task

# 代码反例（connect_proxy.rs:296）：pump 内的 writer.write_all 未包 timeout，且不在 select! 的 IDLE_TIMEOUT 分支内。
# 复现方式：客户端 CONNECT 成功后停止 read（SO_RCVBUF 打满），上游持续写入 → 该 pump 永久停在 296，
# read 侧 300 s 空闲超时永不触发，连接只能等 GATE_CONNECT_MAX_LIFETIME_SECS（缺省 86400 s）兜底。
# 观测：ss -tno state established '( sport = :3102 )' 显示 send-q 持续非零且连接存活 >300 s。

unshare -r -n bash -s <<'EOS'
ip link set lo up
nc -l 127.0.0.1 3102 >/dev/null 2>&1 &
NCPID=$!
sleep 0.5
GATE_CONNECT_LISTEN=127.0.0.1:3102 HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT=3999 TUNNEL_TOKEN_HASH=deadbeef /home/dm/pproxy/target/debug/pproxy-gate-server >/dev/null 2>&1 &
GPID=$!
sleep 2
kill -0 $GPID 2>/dev/null && echo "gate still alive: no fail-fast on CONNECT bind failure"
ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep 3102
kill $GPID $NCPID 2>/dev/null
EOS
# 实测：gate 进程继续存活（退出码 0 语义），3102 仍由 nc 持有，CONNECT 数据面缺席且仅有一行 error 日志
